claims.claim_text: Popular legislation and well-intentioned politicians can create more favorable conditions for change but cannot alone achieve the revolutionary overhaul sought by Red Star.
Red Star seeks a complete upheaval of the economic system that extracts value from the many for the private profit of the few.
